SIDDHAM: IN060027
PennGlobal: PMR14
Period: Vikrama year 1091
Location: City Palace, Dhār, now British Museum no. 1919,1224.1
Dynasty: Paramāra
King: Bhoja
Language: Sanskrit verse Śārdūlavikrīḍita with prose colophon
Script: Nāgarī
Gist: Dedication of a Jain image of Ambikā 
Published reference: Trivedi, no. 14
